tools.name: pins_search
tools.description: Search real-time Pinterest pins by aesthetic or product query (e.g. "ceramic mug", "japandi living room") with zero Pinterest OAuth approval. Returns HD image URLs, dimensions/aspect ratio, extracted dominant hex color + multi-swatch palette, save/repin velocity, creator profile, and outbound shop d

tools.name: pins_details
tools.description: Retrieve complete metadata for any Pinterest pin by numeric pin_id or full pinterest.com/pin/... URL, including original high-res image, dominant hex color, 5-color swatch palette, save count, creator info, and outbound e-commerce URL. Cost: 5 Credits / pin (0 Credits if not found).

tools.name: boards_search
tools.description: Search curated Pinterest moodboards and collections by topic or aesthetic (e.g. "mid century interior", "bridal editorial") with pin counts, cover images, sample thumbnails, color swatches, and creator handles. Cost: 2 Credits / board returned (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: users_profile
tools.description: Fetch public Pinterest creator or verified merchant profile stats (follower count, verified merchant flag, aesthetic dominant palette, and recent top pins) by username or profile URL. Cost: 10 Credits / profile (0 Credits if 404).

tools.name: stays_search
tools.description: Search real-time Airbnb & boutique short-term stays in any city or region with nightly rates, total trip pricing, Superhost badges, star ratings, review counts, GPS coordinates, and high-res interior photography. Cost: 5 Credits / stay returned (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: stays_market
tools.description: Retrieve market-level short-term rental supply, average ratings, Superhost share, property capacities, amenities, and coordinates for travel analytics in any city market. Cost: 3 Credits / listing returned (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: stays_destinations
tools.description: Resolve partial city, region, or landmark names into canonical destination display names, country codes, and location IDs for stay searches. Cost: 2 Credits / call (0 Credits if empty).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pins_search, pins_details, users_profile, stays_search · Public sink: stays_market.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pins_search, pins_details, users_profile, stays_search · Public sink: stays_market

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
